# SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE - NOT M5 DATA

These four CSVs copy the layout of the Walmart M5 files but every value is randomly
generated by `tests/fixtures/make_synthetic_m5.py` (2 stores, 5 items, 420 days of
history, made-up events). They exist only so the test suite runs fast and offline.

Never use this fixture to produce a published number. Real results come from the real
data, fetched and verified by `m5-download`.
